_comment: Wiring for the six hooks. The event matters: orphan-tooling-guard.py is a Stop hook, not
PreToolUse, and wiring it under PreToolUse means it never sees the event it inspects. An
earlier version of this file did exactly that, so anyone following it installed one hook
into a position where it silently did nothing.
Each hook states its own event in its docstring. Trust that over this file.
